name: Tamjeongjeon
source:
[b]Lady in Mystery[/b] is a [i]Yuri[/i] mystery visual novel set in [b]18th-century Korea[/b],
where disguise, love, and truth intertwine beneath the strict Confucian order.

Once an ordinary noble girl, [b][url=/c19864]Heesoo[/url][/b] lost everything when her family was executed under false charges.
Disguised as a man, she escapes to the capital and opens an information shop called Jeonghuso,
gathering whispers and solving cases to survive.

Five years later, just as she begins to rebuild her life,
a runaway noblewoman named [b][url=/c19866]Juhee[/url][/b] appears—
and Heesoo’s carefully constructed world begins to crack.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[b]《谜中淑女》[/b]是一部设定于[i]百合[/i]悬疑视觉小说，背景为[b]18世纪朝鲜[/b]，
在严格的儒家秩序下，伪装、爱情与真相交织在一起。

曾经是普通贵族女孩的[b][url=/c19864]熙秀[/url][/b]，因家族遭受诬告而被处决，失去了一切。
她伪装成男人逃往首都，开设名为“正户所”的情报店，
靠收集传闻、调查案件维生。

五年后，就在她开始重建生活时，
一名逃跑的贵族女子[b][url=/c19866]珠熙[/url][/b]出现了——
熙秀精心构筑的世界开始崩裂。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578950/]Steam[/url]]
